additional_info.body:
Hello,
My name is Benjamin Perske and I’m working for the company AKKODIS on a BMW charging infrastructure project.
Recently one of our drivers had some issues with one of your stations. The charging session was stopped several times by the station because current limit was set to 0A.
Provider: MBLTY
Location: Anzing
Time : 26.12.2025 19:26 o’clock
SerialNr.: MP/R0170002833
EVSE-ID: DC001*2
Are there any know issues with this station? Could you please have a look at it?
Thank you and best regards
Benjamin Perske
Benjamin Perske
Digital Engineer Consultant E-Mobility & Powertrain Leipzig (DCE)

additional_info.subject: ID0472028-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002833] Charging was stopped CRM:03056000945
additional_info.body:
Dear Benjamin,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support.
Following a review of the information provided, a deeper system check, and a soft reboot of your charging station, we have identified that the fault was caused by the cable temperature sensor.
Currently the charging station is working properly and no errors appear.
We will continue to monitor the charger for the next few days. Should the error recur, we will take the necessary action to resolve it. Otherwise, we will proceed to close the ticket.
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team
